org.apache.coyote

Class AbstractProcessor

  • java.lang.Object
    • org.apache.coyote.AbstractProcessorLight
      • org.apache.coyote.AbstractProcessor
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    ActionHook, Processor
    Direct Known Subclasses:
    AjpProcessor, Http11Processor, StreamProcessor

    public abstract class AbstractProcessor
extends AbstractProcessorLight
implements ActionHook
    Provides functionality and attributes common to all supported protocols (currently HTTP and AJP).
